pages.en: This is Ali. It is time for bed.

pages.tr: Ali banyoya gidiyor. Diş fırçasını alıyor.
pages.en: Ali goes to the bathroom. He takes his toothbrush.

pages.tr: Fırçaya macun sürdük. Şimdi ne yapıyoruz?
pages.en: We put toothpaste on the brush. What do we do now?

pages.tr: Ali dişlerini yavaşça fırçalıyor. Yukarı, aşağı.
pages.en: Ali brushes his teeth slowly. Up and down.
Brushing is done. What do we do now?

result.en: First we rinse our mouth with water.

pages.en: His teeth are clean! How does Ali feel?

result.en: Look, Ali is smiling. Ali is happy.

pages.tr: Ali yatağına gidiyor. İyi geceler, Ali!
pages.en: Ali goes to bed. Good night, Ali!

title.en: What do I do when I am angry?

pages.en: Ali is playing with a toy car with his sister Elif.

pages.tr: Elif arabayı alıyor. Ali'nin arabası gitti.
pages.en: Elif takes the car. Ali's car is gone.

result.en: Look at Ali's face. Ali is angry.
Look at Ali's face. Ali is angry.

pages.tr: Ali çok kızdı. Elinde bir oyuncak var.
pages.en: Ali is very angry. He has a toy in his hand.

result.en: The toy fell. Elif is sad.

pages.tr: Ali "Kızgınım!" dedi. Annesiyle derin bir nefes aldı.
pages.en: Ali said, "I am angry!" He took a deep breath with Mom.

pages.tr: Elif arabayı geri verdi. Sırayla oynadılar.
pages.en: Elif gave the car back. They took turns.
